simple.meaning: מוּשִׁי (Mûwshîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Mushite (collectively) or descendants of Mushi.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מוּשִׁי (H4188) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 3:33, with occurrences in Numbers.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מוּשִׁי (H4188) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מוּשִׁי (H4188) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מוּשִׁי (Mûwshîy) / H4188 is traced through Numbers 3:33, Numbers 26:58 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

structuredEvidence.definition: a Mushite (collectively) or descendants of Mushi

firstOccurrence.englishText: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.

timeline.evidenceText: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.

These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.
